from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracts specific facts from one judgment document needed to match it against the result list."""
    
    document_label: str = Field(description="Unique identifier/title of the document (e.g. '《判决文书 1》')")
    
    # Case Identification
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="Relevant case numbers mentioned (e.g. '(2023) 闽 05 刑初 46 号')")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="Type of case or charge (e.g. '盗窃罪', '发明专利权纠纷', '行政再审')")
    
    # Parties involved
    appellants: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellants (上诉人)")
    appellees: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellees (被上诉人)")
    applicants: list[str] = Field(description="Names of petitioners/applicants (申请人/申诉人)")
    defendants: list[str] = Field(description="Names of defendants (被告人)")
    
    # Decision Details
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="Core ruling (e.g. '驳回上诉，维持原判', '撤销原判，改判', '驳回申诉')")
    case_fee: float | None = Field(description="Amount of the litigation fee in RMB if specified")
    fee_payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the fee if specified")
    
    # Criminal Sentence Details (if applicable)
    sentence_term: str | None = Field(description="Specific sentence term (e.g. '有期徒刑十年', '有期徒刑一年八个月')")
    sentence_start_date: str | None = Field(description="Start date for sentence calculation")
    
    # Grounding
    anchor_quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the key facts and outcome")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
